images.label: Figure 1
images.caption: Engineered taxadiene biosynthetic pathway in S. cerevisiae. Genes highlighted in red represent native genes which have been overexpressed through the integration of one additional copy. Genes highlighted in blue are exogenous genes which were heterologously expressed. Hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA synthase (mvaS) and Acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase (mvaE) from Enterococcus faecalis. Geranylgeranyl diphosphate synthase (crtE) from Xanthophyllomyces dendrorhous and Taxadiene synthase (TASY) from Taxus cuspidata

images.label: Table 1
images.caption: Summary of previous taxadiene biosynthesis yields and conditions using E. coli and S. cerevisiae as microbial hosts

images.label: Figure 2
images.caption: Optimisation of taxadiene titres using episomal TASY expression. a Effect of promoter on taxadiene concentration produced by cells incubated at 30 °C. b Effect of cultivation temperature on taxadiene titre. c Effect of cofactor (Mg²⁺) availability at 20 and 30 °C. d Effect of gene truncation length for taxadiene production at 20 °C. Values shown are mean ± standard deviation for 96-h triplicate cultivations

images.label: Figure 3
images.caption: Chromosomally integrated TASY genetic constructs. From top to bottom are TASY cassettes integrated at loci: ARS1114a, ARS1014a, and ARS1622b, respectively. The genetic designs were visualized by SBOLDesigner 2 [41]. Visual content (top to bottom): ARS1114a locus carries pGAL1-TASY-GFP-tADH1 (TASY+C-terminal GFP, no MBP, no ERG20 fusion); ARS1014a and ARS1622b loci both carry pGAL1-MBP-TASY-ERG20*-tADH1 (N-terminal MBP, TASY, ERG20* F96C fusion). Note: this visual ordering is inconsistent with the Table 2 (p.10) locus labels (see source_gaps).

images.label: Figure 4
images.caption: Summary of taxadiene titers microscale optimisation study. LRS1 indicates titers resulting from episomal TASY expression using the high copy 2-micron plasmid (LRS1) at 30 and 20 °C, respectively. The other titers are from strains with chromosomally integrated TASY variants: LRS2 (TDH3p-TASY-ADH1t), LRS3 (TASY-GFP), LRS4 (TASY-GFP; MBP-TASY-ERG20*) and LRS5 (TASY-GFP; MBP-TASY-ERG20*; MBP-TASY-ERG20*), respectively, grown at 30 °C

images.label: Figure 5
images.caption: Effect of temperature on LRS5 performance in shake flasks. LRS5 was cultivated in 250 mL shake flasks in YPG media at 20 or 30 °C. Taxane accumulation (a) and yeast growth (b) were evaluated after 72 h of cultivation. Error bars represent ± standard deviation for triplicate cultivations

images.label: Figure 6
images.caption: LRS5 gas chromatogram. Results show products produced by LRS5 during the 30 °C shake flask cultivation

images.label: Figure 7
images.caption: Bioreactor studies results and respective taxane concentration kinetics at 20 °C (a, b) and at 30 °C (c, d). LRS5 was cultivated in an Applikon MiniBio 500 bioreactor in yeast extract (1%), peptone (2%), galactose (2%). The pH and dissolved oxygen were monitored online and controlled to set points of 6 and 30%, respectively online

images.label: Figure 8
images.caption: Kinetics of intracellular and total taxadiene titres in high-yielding 20 °C bioreactor cultivation

images.label: Table 2
images.caption: Yeast strains used in this study. Note: per the textual strain-construction narrative (p.5) and Figure 3 visual, the LRS3 TASY-GFP cassette should reside at locus ARS1114a (not ARS1014a as written in this table); LRS4 should add MBP-TASY-ERG20* at ARS1014a (not ARS1622); LRS5 should add the second MBP-TASY-ERG20* at ARS1622b (not ARS1114a). The Table 2 locus labels therefore appear to be systematically relabeled relative to Figure 3 and the textual narrative — an internal inconsistency of the original paper.

source_gaps: 允许的分类路径列表为空 ([ ])，原文不属于单一框架（天然产物新途径发现、单一酶催化机制解析或标准细胞工厂重构），其真实学科方向为代谢工程/合成生物学（优化现有紫杉醇前体途径在酿酒酵母中的表达）。
原文 Additional file 1 中 Figure S1、S2-A 至 S2-F、S3、S4 与 Table S1–S3 仅在正文叙述中提及，本报告的 PDF 截图未独立提供这些附加文件图像，因此本报告仅依赖正文图表与文字描述，未对附加文件内容进行引申推测。

Figure 3 视觉（自上而下 ARS1114a = pGAL1-TASY-GFP-tADH1；ARS1014a 与 ARS1622b = pGAL1-MBP-TASY-ERG20*-tADH1）与 Table 2 (p.10) 中 'LRS3 = mGTy116 ARS1014a::Gal1p-TASY-GFP'、'LRS4 = LRS3 ARS1622::Gal1p-MBP-TASY-ERG20*'、'LRS5 = LRS4 ARS1114a::Gal1p-MBP-TASY-ERG20*' 的位点标签相互矛盾；正文 p.5 同时表述 LRS4 = LRS3 + MBP-TASY-ERG20 at ARS1014a、LRS5 = LRS4 + 第二份 at ARS1622b，与 Figure 3 视觉一致，与 Table 2 不一致；该不一致为原文内部数据冲突，本报告按 Figure 3 视觉与正文叙述为准，并在 Table 2 段明确标注冲突。

正文 p.6 引用 'an almost 6.5-fold improvement over the highest reported titre [8]'，但参考 [8]（Engels 等 2008, 8.7 mg/L）实际给出 129/8.7 ≈ 14.8 倍；与 6.5 倍一致的是参考 [9]（Reider Apel 等 2017, 20 mg/L, 129/20 ≈ 6.45）；Abstract 也未指明出处。该 [8] 实为 [9] 的笔误已在 (四) 摇瓶规模放大段首明确指出。
